description: This file provides helper functions for fetching, normalizing, and processing news articles, particularly India-focused headlines using RSS feeds. It includes functions for fetching RSS feeds, parsing XML, normalizing article data, trimming headlines, stripping HTML, extracting images, and performing keyword searches within fetched news data.

methods.name: normalizeArticles(arr = [], overrides = {})
methods.description: Normalizes raw RSS feed items into a consistent article format suitable for display, applying defaults, extracting images, and formatting timestamps.

methods.name: trimHeadline(text, maxLen = 110)
methods.description: Removes common long suffix patterns from headlines and truncates them to a maximum length for readability.

methods.name: stripHtml(html = "")
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string to produce plain text.

methods.name: extractFirstImageFromHtml(html = "")
methods.description: Extracts the URL of the first image found in an HTML string, if any.

methods.name: timeAgo(iso)
methods.description: Converts an ISO timestamp into a relative time string like '2h ago'.

methods.name: fetchRssFeedItems({ rssUrl })
methods.description: Fetches and parses an RSS or Atom feed URL into a list of article objects.

methods.name: nodeToItem(n)
methods.description: Converts an RSS <item> node into a plain object with relevant fields.

methods.name: nodeToAtomItem(n)
methods.description: Converts an Atom <entry> node into a plain object with relevant fields.

methods.name: fetchDefaultIndiaHeadlines()
methods.description: Fetches the latest India headlines from a list of public RSS feeds, defaulting to Times of India and falling back on BBC and The Hindu.

methods.name: searchIndiaNewsByKeyword(keyword)
methods.description: Filters fetched India headlines by a keyword, performing client-side search on title and excerpt.

methods.name: getReadableLocationString(coords)
methods.description: Creates a human-readable location string from latitude and longitude coordinates.
